suites.reason: Semantic hardening consolidation (branch claude/semantic-compiler-hardening merged onto the enforcement baseline): comma-listed conditions, unconditional statements, dropped-operand and permission-rule capability minting, OCR-unavailable fail-closed behaviour. No evaluation version change, no golden expectation change.

dispositions.reason: Semantic hardening consolidation: cross-path/provenance coverage denominators shrank (cross-path comparable units 368 -> 350; three capabilities that had silently lost condition operands or were minted from a permission "may" rule no longer resolve), so the unchanged metric value is measured over fewer units. This is a deliberate precision gain (fewer spurious resolved capabilities), recorded as an acknowledged coverage reduction, not tuned away. See CHANGELOG.md.
Semantic hardening consolidation: the observed node population grew because unconditional-statement nodes were added; coverage stays 100%, so this is a population change, not a failure.
